reviewType: Independent read-only dispatcher source and retained-evidence review; persisted after the original chat verdict
resolvedFindings: Host intents, input/response artifacts, observations and final evidence use exclusive creation and fsync. A preexisting run directory blocks another invocation; no automatic retry is introduced.

The exact task template bytes are pinned and registered canonical taskInput is re-described and compared before RunTask. The unchanged reviewed inner script/rates, four DB secret references, API image/source, current release approval and both healthy service snapshots remain required.

Task stop handling, log collection, final task readback and task-definition deregistration are independent guarded phases. A polling or stop failure no longer skips collection of committed inner evidence. Raw log pages are fsynced before interpretation, and collection tolerates transient empty tails and bounded ingestion lag.
controlFlowConclusions: The unchanged inner module owns canonical binding and budget installation. The outer script neither manufactures owners nor seeds/resets fixtures; execute is constructed only from the successful exact-source prior plan and the inner owner still rebuilds/checks its plan and CAS state.

Wrapper finally transports complete saved JSONL bytes using bounded numbered base64 chunks and exact source/script/rate/run/path/length/hash/exit metadata. Host assembly rejects duplicate, missing, reordered, malformed, noncanonical or mismatched frames and saves complete bytes before inner JSONL interpretation.

Actual failure receipts and every returned raw log page are retained separately from success. Unchanged forward tokens are temporary tails; collection has a 180-second scheduling window, at most 60 requests and a 32 MiB accepted-page budget. Per-call read timeout can extend a scheduling window; it is not a hard wall-clock deadline.

Registration, RunTask, stop and deregistration each have one awsSingleAttempt mutation call site. Their durable intents precede dispatch. Bounded read-only task discovery can recover only the exact startedBy nonce/task definition for cleanup after an unknown RunTask response; original dispatch failure remains fatal and cannot be converted to green.
Task and stream identity are tied to the owned ARN, exact task definition, capiro-dev cluster and persisted startedBy. Cleanup does not invoke a global drain or stop unrelated tasks.

Success requires complete exact inner stages/sequence, no inner/wrapper failure, zero inner and actual ECS exit, actual owned STOPPED task with the exact container/image/digest, independently read-back INACTIVE definition, no fatal observation and no evidence persistence failure. Committed inner status is reported separately from a blocked/uncertain outer result.
Unknown registration, run, cleanup or final evidence outcomes require scoped reconciliation. No mutation replay, automatic refund, compensation, second bind/install or provider execution is added.

retainedQualification.scope: Exact extracted pure assembler cases and generated wrapper syntax, plus whole-dispatcher syntax. No dispatcher import or execution; no AWS/task/log/cleanup integration test.

limits: This technical source verdict is not release approval, capture authorization or proof that setup has run.

At review no live inner JSONL receipt, task image execution, CloudWatch transport or cleanup integration was supplied by these parser checks. Actual successful plan/execute artifacts remain necessary.

The fixed receipt/source/template/rate and reviewed release assumptions must still hold at explicit invocation. Native capture, actual paid evidence, original acceptance and human adjudication remain separate.
Post-failure discovery is bounded and may be inconclusive; the result remains uncertain and never licenses automatic replay.
